title: Amodei, Altman, and Musk rally around call to slow AI down
excerpt: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for an AI slowdown on Saturday. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceXAI CEO Elon Musk, and others, also chimed in.
content_html:
AI leaders rally around calls to slow things down

By Truman Dickerson

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The leaders of US AI labs are having a come-together moment.

After Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said on Saturday that he's "become convinced" AI needs to pace its development to avert disaster, other AI leaders quickly logged on to endorse the idea.

Most notably, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said on X, "I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier."

Altman said OpenAI would commit, as Anthropic had earlier, to embedding third-party safety evaluators within the company with employee-level access.

SpaceXAI CEO Elon Musk, who rarely agrees with Altman, also backed Amodei's proposals on Saturday, writing in an X post, "Dario is right."

Other prominent industry leaders also chimed in.

Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue said on X that his company was launching an "open alignment initiative" and asked to be included in the labs employing third-party safety evaluators.

Andrej Karpathy, an AI researcher and former OpenAI and Tesla executive, also endorsed Amodei's plan to better monitor AI's development and ensure its safety. "I love this and really hope we can come together as an industry and make it happen," he said on X.

Google DeepMind founder Demis Hassabis has yet to weigh in on Saturday. The AI leader, however, has previously called for more cooperation among AI leaders and governments.

"That calls for public policy that promotes innovation while also incentivizing responsibility and security, fosters international collaboration on key safety issues, and encourages careful consideration of how AI is deployed for the benefit of society," he wrote in a lengthy X post in July.

This is a developing story and will be updated.
